# Refactor Code

Refactor selected code without behavior change.

## Rules

- Do not change public contracts.
- Do not change business rules.
- Do not change database/message contracts.
- Do not add dependencies unless necessary.
- Keep changes focused and small.
- Preserve tests; add tests if current behavior is unprotected.

Explain what improved and how behavior was preserved.
